title: Brick Bash
description: The classic: bounce the ball, smash the bricks, don't let it past. Tougher bricks take a few hits, steel ones don't break at all. Catch the snacks that drop out for a wide paddle, extra balls, slow-mo or an extra life.
instructions: Move with the mouse, or the arrow keys or A/D. Space or click to launch. On a phone, drag to move and tap to launch.
